newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian cargo plane missing in Siberia.
newsitem.headline: Russian cargo plane missing in Siberia.

text.p: A Russian air force Ilyushin Il-76 cargo plane with 19 people aboard went missing in Siberia on Wednesday evening, a spokeswoman for the Emergency Services Ministry in Moscow said.

The heavy four-engined jet took off at 1647 GMT from Abakan on a flight to Petropavlovsk-Kamchatsky on the far eastern Kamchatka peninsula. "They lost contact seven minutes later," she said, adding that search crews were heading for the area.
The plane, which had a crew of six, was carrying 13 passengers and 30 tonnes of freight, the spokeswoman said.
Rescue workers had left the southern Siberian city of Krasnoyarsk to look for the aircraft.
The Il-76, designed as a military tank transporter, has become a familiar cargo carrier around the world.

A number have been involved in accidents in recent months, including a civilian freighter owned by the Kazakh airline KazAir, which was involved in the world's worst mid-air collision with a Saudi jumbo jet near Delhi on November 12.
